key: ???: Here is a space in which has been gathered no shortage of things that do not belong.
en: ???: Here is a space in which has been gathered no shortage of things that do not belong.
ja: ???: ここは、あるべきでないものたちが、数多く集められた場所。

key: I am here,
en: I am here,
ja: わたしがいて、

key: And so are you,
en: And so are you,
ja: あなたもいて、

key: And so are memories, wishes, and all of our other precious, unreal things.
en: And so are memories, wishes, and all of our other precious, unreal things.
ja: 記憶も、願いも、わたしたちの大切で非現実的なものたちも、みなここにいる。

key: What you seek can yet be seen, but don't assume it's not a dream.
en: What you seek can yet be seen, but don't assume it's not a dream.
ja: あなたの探すものは、まだ見ることができる。でも、それが夢でないとは思わないで。

key: We are gathered here today in loving memory of Elizabeth Connal,
en: We are gathered here today in loving memory of Elizabeth Connal,
ja: 本日ここに、エリザベス・コナルをしのび、集いました。

key: Who, in death as in health, shall depart from us as a beacon of light, life, and a reminder to spare gratitude for what small joys we may yet have...
en: Who, in death as in health, shall depart from us as a beacon of light, life, and a reminder to spare gratitude for what small joys we may yet have...
ja: 彼女は、健やかなる時も、死してもなお、光と生命の道しるべとして、そしてなお残る小さな喜びに感謝を惜しまぬようにという教えとして、わたしたちのもとを去っていく……

key: She won't respond anymore.
en: She won't respond anymore.
ja: 彼女はもう応えない。

key: MOTHER: Lizzy--
en: MOTHER: Lizzy--
ja: 母: リジー――

key: I'm so sorry---
en: I'm so sorry---
ja: ごめんなさい――

key: I'm so, so sorry...
en: I'm so, so sorry...
ja: 本当に、本当にごめんなさい……

key: FATHER: ...
en: FATHER: ...

key: So this is how it ends...
en: So this is how it ends...
ja: こうやって終わるのか……

key: They say she found a whole bottle of pills somewhere and chased it down all at once...
en: They say she found a whole bottle of pills somewhere and chased it down all at once...
ja: どこかで薬瓶を丸ごと見つけて、一気に飲み下したらしい……

key: I knew something was off.
en: I knew something was off.
ja: 何かおかしいとは思っていた。

key: Couldn't I have done anything...?
en: Couldn't I have done anything...?
ja: 私に何かできなかったのか……?

key: EUPHIE: ...
en: EUPHIE: ...
ja: ユーフィ: ……

key: I don't know what I expected.
en: I don't know what I expected.
ja: 何を期待してたんだろう。

key: This is her twisted world.
en: This is her twisted world.
ja: ここは彼女のねじれた世界。

key: She may be gone, but it plays by her rules.
en: She may be gone, but it plays by her rules.
ja: いなくなっても、ルールは彼女のままだ。

key: She's still pulling the strings.
en: She's still pulling the strings.
ja: まだ彼女が糸を引いてる。

key: And either way, I don't want to be here.
en: And either way, I don't want to be here.
ja: どっちにしても、ここにはいたくない。

key: Not like this.
en: Not like this.
ja: こんな形では。

key: That-- what you saw,
en: That-- what you saw,
ja: あれは――あなたが見たものは、

key: Was a bad memory.
en: Was a bad memory.
ja: 嫌な記憶だった。

key: But it led to the twins and I becoming closer.
en: But it led to the twins and I becoming closer.
ja: でもそれがきっかけで、双子と私は近づいた。

key: And eventually, when they had to make a difficult decision, I was all too happy to be their martyr.
en: And eventually, when they had to make a difficult decision, I was all too happy to be their martyr.
ja: やがて彼らが厳しい決断を迫られた時、私は喜んで彼らの犠牲になった。

key: A wish to save the world--
en: A wish to save the world--
ja: 世界を救う願い――

key: Something like that is impossible.
en: Something like that is impossible.
ja: そんなもの、不可能だ。

key: Not without sacrifice.
en: Not without sacrifice.
ja: 犠牲なしには無理。

key: I never cared for this body anyway,
en: I never cared for this body anyway,
ja: どのみち、この身体に執着なんてなかった。

key: I think it's something like a glitch that it was even returned to me.
en: I think it's something like a glitch that it was even returned to me.
ja: これが私に返ってきたこと自体、バグみたいなものだと思う。

key: And I'm sure it's only been returned to me for the sake of some cruel play in Lin's game.
en: And I'm sure it's only been returned to me for the sake of some cruel play in Lin's game.
ja: きっと、リンのゲームの中の残酷な芝居のために返されただけ。

key: I don't accept that.
en: I don't accept that.
ja: それは受け入れない。

key: I'm going back in.
en: I'm going back in.
ja: 戻る。

key: Going back to sleep.
en: Going back to sleep.
ja: 眠りに戻る。

key: Going back to dream.
en: Going back to dream.
ja: 夢に戻る。

key: You know me by my dream.
en: You know me by my dream.
ja: 私のことは、夢の中の私として知っているはず。

key: For something I was supposed to be losing, I got more out of it than I ever expected.
en: For something I was supposed to be losing, I got more out of it than I ever expected.
ja: 失うはずだったものから、思っていた以上のものを得た。

key: Ethereal guardianship-- still the power to make a difference, and none of the dysphoria...
en: Ethereal guardianship-- still the power to make a difference, and none of the dysphoria...
ja: 幽体の守護者――それでも何かを変える力はあるし、性別違和もない……

key: Also, let's be real--
en: Also, let's be real--
ja: それに、正直に言えば――

key: It's great for fucking with people.
en: It's great for fucking with people.
ja: 人をおちょくるには最高。

key: You should hear the challengers when they come into the gym for the first time.
en: You should hear the challengers when they come into the gym for the first time.
ja: 挑戦者たちが初めてジムに入ってきた時の反応、聞かせてあげたいくらい。

key: Or was that you, too, back then?
en: Or was that you, too, back then?
ja: それとも、あの時のあなたもそうだった?

key: It does all blur together.
en: It does all blur together.
ja: 全部ぼやけて混ざり合う。

key: But better a delicious delirium than an agonizing ad nauseum, no?
en: But better a delicious delirium than an agonizing ad nauseum, no?
ja: でも、うんざりするほどの繰り返しより、心地よい錯乱の方がまだましでしょ?

key: Step aside.
en: Step aside.
ja: どいて。

key: EUPHIE: I'll see you again sometime,
en: EUPHIE: I'll see you again sometime,
ja: ユーフィ: またいつか会いましょう、

key: Maybe even with a smile on my face.
en: Maybe even with a smile on my face.
ja: もしかしたら、笑顔で。
